notes: The per-property DPR 523 forms of the Market & Octavia Augmentation Survey — the survey the 2007 Market & Octavia context statement (batch market-octavia-hcs) was written to accompany, and which that statement does not carry. SF Planning publishes them on its Historic Preservation survey-forms page as Adobe PDF Packages and single PDFs; a package holds one form per address as an embedded file. Page & Turnbull did the fieldwork in 2006; Kelley & VerPlanck wrote the 2010 evaluations. Each form states the address, the assessor's block and lot outright, a construction date with the source it came from, and a California Historical Resource status code; the A+B forms outside the Hayes Valley set add an architectural style, and some add an architect, a builder and a dated construction history. The 276 Hayes Valley district forms are Primary Records only — no B record, so no style and no architect. Owner names on every form's P7 field were not extracted, per the privacy limits.

coverage.remaining: Three district-level records read but not extracted, because they describe a district rather than a numbered address: the Hayes Valley Residential Historic District 523D form and its 523L update, and the Pine 1644-1670 district record. Each lists contributors by address and is worth a separate pass.
coverage.note: Every form in the batch names one numbered address, so the form count and the mention count are the same.
